title: A bouncing ball
description:
Move a ball with its speed and frame time, bouncing off the screen edges.

```
800x450 screen, ball r=20 at (400, 225), speed (300, 200) px/s, dt 1/60
after 60 frames: (700.0, 425.0)  -> about to hit the bottom
after 63 frames: bounced, speed y now -200
```
hints: `if (b.y + b.r > height) { b.y = height - b.r; b.vy = -b.vy; }`, and the same for the other three walls (lesson 1.04).
In the raylib version, `GetFrameTime()` gives `dt` and `DrawCircleV` draws the ball.
requirements: When the ball's edge passes a wall, put it back inside and flip that speed.
Simulate 300 frames and check the ball never leaves the screen.
stretch: Add gravity and a little energy lost on each bounce.
